chunks: Faḍālah narrated from al-Qāsim ibn Burayd, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
If a free man divorces a bondwoman and she observes part of her waiting period from him, then she is freed, then she observes the waiting period of a bondwoman.

key_terms.تَعْتَدُّ: she observes or completes the waiting period
key_terms.عِدَّةَ الْمَمْلُوكَةِ: the waiting period prescribed for a bondwoman
key_terms.عِدَّتِهَا: her ʿiddah; legally mandated waiting period

ai.seo_question: If a bondwoman is divorced and then freed during her ʿiddah, does she complete the waiting period as a free woman or as a bondwoman?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the ʿiddah of a bondwoman divorced by a free man. If she begins her waiting period while still enslaved and is then freed before it ends, she continues and completes the ʿiddah according to the ruling of a bondwoman.
